Ensure that the game is working correctly, and rectify any problems (except kicker problems) before commencing this work. Ensure that the game is switched OFF and the power is disconnected before removing any parts. Seperate the Kicker and Monitor Cabinets. 1. Remove 4off hex head screws (M6x20), with spring washers. 2. Raise the level adjusters on the Kicker Cabinet and remove the adjustable feet holders before moving it away from the Monitor Cabinet. (Failure to raise the adjusters may cause the adjusters to be bent or damaged). 3. Take care when moving the Kicker Cabinet not to stretch the looms before disconnecting the connectors. Remove the Kicker Assemblies. 1. Remove 2off whizz nuts (M10) and remove the rear Fixing Bracket. Fixing bracket Whizz nut (M10) 2. Remove 4off torx security screw (M6x20), 4off socket button head screw (M6x20) and remove the Front Protectors (left and right). Remove 2off torx security screw (M6x20) and remove the Front Protector (centre). 3. Disconnect the connectors from the Kicker Assemblies. 4. Remove 2off hex head screw (M10x30) from the front of each Kicker Assy. Torx security screw (M6x20) Hex head screw (M10x30) Front protector (left) Front protector (centre) Torx Security screw (M6x20) Torx security screw (M6x20) Front protector (right) Socket button head screw (M6x20) 5. Withdraw the Kicker Assy from the front of the cabinet.

Fitting the New Nylon Washer 1. Remove 1off Full nut (M6) and remove the Spring Shaft complete with Spring, and Spring Ends. Spring shaft game —_ Io / Spring D 2. When reassembling the new Spring Shaft refit the spring ends in the opposite positions (front spring end refitted to the back and the back spring end refitted to the front). 3. Fit the new Nylon Washer on to the spring shaft in front of the front spring end and refit the Spring Shaft to the Kicker Assembly. 4. Refit the shaft to the Kicker Assembly using 1off Whizz nut (M6) supplied and with Loctite 242 applied to the thread. Whizz nut (M6) Spring shaft (fit with New Nylon Washer Spring ends Loctite 242 (Part No 47000208) applied) S Spring A Reverse positions of spring ends when refitting to the new shaft. Note: When tightening the Whizz nut ensure that the nut welded to the shaft is retained with a spanner to ensure that the Whizz nut is fully tightened. Failure to tighten the Whizz nut fully may allow the shaft to come loose during game play causing damage to the shaft.

Re-assembly and Testing 1. 2. Refit the Kicker Assemblies to the cabinet. Refit the Front Protectors. . Rejoin the Kicker Cabinet to the Monitor Cabinet. (Take care not to trap any wires when rejoining the cabinets). . Refit the Adjustable Feet Holders and lower the Level Adjusters. . Re-initialize the game. The following operation must always be performed after replacing the NAOMI Game PCB, Joystick Potentiometers or initializing the backup data.. The game will not operate correctly if these adjustments are not made. a) Slide the TEST switch ON while pressing and holding the SERVICE switch. The following screen is displayed. b) Ensure that all joysticks are in their central position, then press the Service button to initialize the setting details. 4 VF INITIALIZE ) I KEEP STICKS CENTRE POSITION] I AND PRESS SERVICE SW I GOTO[SWITCH TEST] aneessedhssessssseeeeeee (a) SELECT SW = :CHOOSE ENTER SW : ENTER Ne w c). Switch Test When Switch Test is selected and entered from the I/F Initaialize screen the following screen is displayed. la VO TEST >) LINK : OFF SWITCHTEST [ON RED] COIN 0 1) SERVICE OFF 2) TEST OFF 3) SELECT (UP/DOWN) OFF/OFF 4) ENTER ) STICK (+) (+) GC (-} (L/R) 8765 7765 6765 5765 (U/D) 8765 7765 6765 5765 BUTTON OFF OFF OFF OFF KICK 0000 0000 0000 0000 - (FRONT/ BACK) OFF/OFF OFF/OFF OFF/OFF ——= UP SELECT SW + ENTER SW : EXIT The SWITCH TEST screen displays the status of the switches. The display changes when any of the switches are operated. Press both Select Up switch and Enter Switch together to exit and return to the Menu. The number increments each time a coin signal is received. The display changes from OFF to ON each time the respective switch is operated. A bar extends from the centre corresponding to the direction and deflection of the joystick. The figure changes corresponding to the joystick angle when the joystick is tilted. The figure will change colour when the joystick is tilted to its maximum angle of defelection. (7) is for the left/right direction, and (8) is for the forward/backward direction. The dispaly changes from OFF to ON when either of the start buttons are pressed. Displays the input force of the ball assembly used during the game. The left OFF changes to ON, (ON/OFF), when the ball is kicked gently and the right OFF changes to ON, (ON/ON), when the ball is kicked hard. A red bar is displayed above the line when the ball is kicked. The bar length indicates the kick speed.
